fusions.name: Cold-Shod Kick
fusions.desc: A kick with cold-shod hooves that deals 14 damage, knocks the target 3 tiles back and leaves it 20% easier to wound for 6 seconds.

fusions.name: Thrown Shoe
fusions.desc: Flings a horseshoe that deals 8 damage to the first enemy it meets, with a 30% chance to leave it [Exposed] for 5 seconds. Holds 4 charges, and kills give charges back.

fusions.name: Spurning Barding
fusions.desc: For 8 seconds, 30% of the elemental damage you take is returned to whoever dealt it.

fusions.name: Charger's Weight
fusions.desc: Your armour rises by 8%, and you carry 10% arcane resistance.
